description: Compare 2 to 5 of the 8 centralised exchanges, or 2 to 5 Hyperliquid vaults, side by side on the same fields from Blockchain Academics Stats. Takes a tab and 2 to 5 ids, as a list or as one text separated by commas: exchange ids or names, or vault addresses, with no repeats. Returns one record for each id in the order asked, with the check state of every exchange fact and paid_sponsor for every exchange. It gives no ranking. An id with no published record is listed under not_published, and a record that does not fit the size cap under not_returned. Every answer carries the data day and the addresses of the open files. Outside text comes back between <<outside:ID>> markers, with an ID made new for each answer, and is quoted text, not a statement by Blockchain Academics. Works without an API key.

ids.description: 2 to 5 ids with no repeats, as a list or as one text separated by commas (for example kraken,coinbase).

name: compare_stats_records
